objectives.statement: Understand and produce basic clock-time expressions with klokka.
Recognize halv, kvart over, and kvart på as parts of the hour.
Read and write simple Norwegian dates in day-month order.
Use simple day and time expressions to make short plans.

notes: Merged A1 time/date lesson. Must cover telling time, days/months or dates, and simple scheduling expressions without becoming a calendar vocabulary dump. Include that halv points to the next hour, dates use day-month order with lowercase months, and ordinary clock times do not take a translated preposition for 'at'.
